title: Rav Kahana bar Tuvia

paragraphs: Hyman reports him in the Salonika printing at [Eruvin 8a (8b in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.8b.7); the text Hyman uses reads bar Malkiyu.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Kahana bar Tachlifa cite Kahana bar Minyumi, who cites Kahana bar Malkiyu in the name of Rav’s teacher, also called Rav Kahana.

The Bavli also gives a version identifying Malkiyu with Rav’s teacher. [Heilprin’s entry on Malkiyu](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2300&lang=en) uses that name. Hyman reports bar Tuvia from the Salonika printing and gives 8a.
